text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B repeatedly because it was above my average cost felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a sound reason to sell; I should consider its outlook and my portfolio balance.","Those sales reduced my exposure to Stock B, and buying it back later at a higher price shows the cost of trading without a clear plan. I should avoid chasing price moves.","My account fell substantially while I made few decisions. Since I trade rarely, I should review each holding periodically against clear goals, rather than letting discomfort with losses or pleasure in gains drive my choices."]}
